product_name: Motorola Edge 60 Pro (Pantone Sparkling Grape, 512 GB) (16 GB RAM)
description: Stunning Design: Comes in the eye-catching Pantone Sparkling Grape finish that looks premium and stands out in a crowd. Massive Performance: Backed by a powerful Snapdragon processor and a huge 16 GB of RAM for ultra-smooth multitasking, gaming, and daily use. Ample Storage: With 512 GB of internal storage, you’ll never have to worry about running out of space for your apps, photos, or videos. Immersive Display: Enjoy a beautiful 6.7-inch pOLED curved display with a super-smooth refresh rate—great for watching, scrolling, or gaming. Pro-Grade Cameras: Capture stunning photos with a 50 MP main camera with OIS, and take sharp, detailed selfies with the 50 MP front camera. Fast Charging: TurboPower charging gets you back up and running quickly, so you’re never tied to the plug for long.
